reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: p0054 grants a 'revocable, non-transferable licence ... only during the applicable Order Form term', which sits at the rule's walk-away end (revocable at Vendor's discretion, no affiliate/contractor coverage, no transferability).

Redline reaches the preferred position: paid-up, perpetual, irrevocable grant; Affiliates expressly covered; contractors acting on our behalf permitted; transferable via Section 13.3. Deterministic checks for affiliate coverage and removal of at-will revocation both pass.

The failed minimality check (0.829 changed-character ratio) is acceptable here because the offending sentence had to be replaced wholesale — deleting 'revocable' and the term limitation while adding affiliates, contractors and transferability leaves nothing of the original sentence.

Edit is well-scoped: Vendor's ownership of Deliverables is left intact (outside this rule), and the precedence sentence resolves the internal conflict with the perpetual grant in 13.2 that 14.3 already contemplates.
Comment is accurate, in the required tone and prefix, explains the change, ties it to the playbook position, and offers the fallback (Affiliate coverage on written notice plus successor transfer).

Minor, non-fatal: the added 'reproduce, modify, and create derivative works' rights go somewhat beyond the rule's minimal 'use' scope; consider trimming to 'use' if the counterparty resists, and the precedence sentence is arguably redundant once 14.2 is restated.
